units.function: Authorizes Issue review verdict actors under anyone, human-only or not-requester policies and recognizes the requester-created confirmation associated with the latest transition into review.
units.dependencyDirection: Issue review-policy service -> shared policy type, Drizzle activity log and structured HTTP errors; caller supplies current Issue, actor and optional policy override and is expected to enforce Issue write access.
units.keyDataModels: Typed Agent/user actor and requester; Issue company/review policy/creator; latest activity transition with old/new status and reviewInteractionId; stable review_policy_denied error metadata.
units.lifecycle: Resolve effective policy -> return immediately for anyone, type-check human_only, or reconstruct latest review requester from tenant-scoped activity/fallback creator -> compare typed actor -> allow or issue structured denial; separately bind the recorded confirmation ID to requester identity.
units.testAssessment: The paired 5-test real-database suite skipped in both environments; TypeScript passed. Intended tests cover default behavior, transition-aware requester exclusion, snapshot noise, interaction identity and human principal type. Missing are override authorization, reopen/multiple rounds, policy versioning, history loss/tamper, tenant attacks, membership/grants, quorum/conflicts and exact content binding.
units.designRationale: Offer minimal, explicit self-review prevention and human-only review without coupling generic confirmation resolution to one actor class, while preserving compatibility with two activity payload generations.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS needs immutable, round-specific ReviewObligations and ApprovalObligations whose actors, authority, policy and reviewed evidence/action digest remain provable throughout audit and recovery.
units.companyOsFit: ADAPT typed actor matching, tenant-scoped transition evidence, stable error codes and fail-closed unknown requester. Resolve policy exclusively from a versioned obligation snapshot, never a request override; use stable Principal/role/certification/grant records; model review rounds, quorum and conflicts; bind decision to Work/action/artifact/evidence digest and append an immutable verdict receipt.
units.responsibilityConflict: The caller can supply an effective policy, null Issue policy defaults to anyone, and human_only proves only that authentication produced a user-shaped actor. A current activity reconstruction cannot prove which exact content or risk policy the verdict covered.
evidence: paired focused Vitest: 5/5 skipped in sandbox and approved unsandboxed run
units.securityFindings: CRITICAL policy-integrity risk for Company OS: optional effective-policy input and no immutable policy/content digest can authorize against a weaker or changed rule. HIGH default-open and human-authority gaps. HIGH audit-history dependence without retention/tamper tests. HIGH verification gap: database suite skipped. MEDIUM round ambiguity after repeated in_review transitions. POSITIVE: company-scoped history, typed identities, fail-closed unknown requester and stable codes are useful foundations.
